reviewNotes: Tone note: "Masses" (the PO's capital M) is about devotion, not looking down on anyone. The post praises owners who add M parts one at a time and says nothing about other cars or owners.
Not used: the M Sport II steering wheel (no picture of it on the car) and the Laser seats (already in P2, P4 and P14).
